items.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for rape and sexual assault
items.brief: Disgraced British comedian and actor Russell Brand was sentenced on Monday to 10 years and six months in prison after being convicted of raping a fan and assaulting three women during his showbiz career.

items.title: Nvidia is in peril. Can it survive without Jensen Huang?
items.brief: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he wants to die at his desk.

items.title: US FDA orders new eye risk warnings for Ozempic, Zepbound
items.brief: The US health regulator on Monday informed patients and healthcare providers of a potential increased ​risk of a serious eye condition associated with the use of ‌GLP-1 drugs for weight loss and diabetes.

items.title: France blames Iran for ‘unprecedented’ supermarket fridge cyberattack
items.brief: France’s Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has blamed Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps for last month’s supermarket fridge cyberattack which spoiled fresh and frozen produce at around 700 retailers.

items.title: Nvidia stock falls after probe into CEO’s affair with alleged foreign spy
items.brief: Nvidia shares fell roughly 5% on Monday after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair and the company said it was investigating reports he was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort.”
